command: import json,torch; x=torch.tensor([-9.,-1.,0.,2.],device='cuda',dtype=torch.float64,requires_grad=True); loss=-torch.special.log_ndtr(x).mean(); loss.backward(); assert bool(torch.isfinite(loss)) and x.grad is not None and bool(torch.isfinite(x.grad).all()); print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','dtype':str(x.dtype),'device':str(x.device),'loss':float(loss),'gradient_norm':float(x.grad.norm())}))
